component.name: Pohoda Tools
component.summary: CLI helpers for Stormware Pohoda mServer

description.p: Command-line helpers for Stormware Pohoda (mServer), useful when testing integrations such as changes-API pollers.
Includes pohoda-fake-bank, which inserts a synthetic bank receipt so pollers can observe a new document via lastChanges or MSSQL DatSave.
